about: Motion-graphics agent skills OneClip installs into .claude/skills and .agents/skills (list from trinhstudio.com/inside/claude-motion-graphics-repos-2026). These are third-party: OneClip fetches them from their own repos on your machine, each at its pinned commit, and does not ship them. Move the pins with `pnpm skills --latest --pin` and a reviewed PR. Read each repo's licence before client work.
